name: Chengdu Xingrong Environment Co., Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Xingrong Environment Co., Ltd. engages in the tap water business in China. It is involved in the water extraction from water sources, water purification, water pipe transportation, and tap water sales and after-sales services. The company also engages in the sewage treatment business, such as urban and rural domestic sewage and industrial wastewater. In addition, it is involved in the environmental protection business, including waste incineration power generation, landfill leachate treatment, sludge and food waste disposal, and engineering businesses. The company was formerly known as Chengdu Xingrong Investment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Chengdu Xingrong Environment Co., Ltd…
